title: AI Enablement Software Engineer (m/f/n)
description:
Summary
AI is reshaping how software gets built, and we're moving fast to make it a standard part of engineering at scale. With an estate of more than 3,000 repositories, we have one of the largest and most interesting AI enablement challenges in the industry — and we're looking for the person who wants to participate on it.

Job description

This role is about turning AI from promise into measurable impact. You'll build the configurations, tooling, and patterns that let delivery teams plug AI directly into their day-to-day work, and you'll lead the mentoring classes and educational sessions that spread that capability across the organization.

If you're a senior engineer who loves both deep technical work and helping teams adopt AI confidently, this is a rare chance to shape how thousands of engineers work every day.

What you will do

- Configure repositories for AI — design, build, and roll out repeatable configurations (rules, instructions, context files, MCP/tool integrations, CI hooks) across a large and diverse repository estate.

- Develop internal AI apps for software engineering — build practical tools, assistants, dashboards, and workflow integrations that help engineering teams use AI safely and effectively in daily development, testing, code review, documentation, and repository maintenance.

- Deliver end-to-end solutions, not advice — prepare functional, production-ready setups that teams can adopt without rebuilding them from scratch.

- Scale enablement — replace repetitive tasks with automation, build self-service tooling, and reusable playbooks so hundreds of teams can be onboarded without proportional effort.

- Act as the internal AI advocate — stay ahead of tooling developments, evaluate new capabilities, and set standards and best practices for AI usage in engineering.

What you bring

Required

- Extensive hands-on software engineering experience (3+ years), with credibility across multiple languages, stacks, and repository setups.

- Practical experience configuring and using AI coding assistants and agentic developer tooling in real codebases.

- Solid Git, CI/CD, and developer-tooling/automation background.

- Ability to work independently, drive initiatives end to end, and operate across many teams at once.

- Fluent English (written and spoken).

Nice to have

- Experience with large-scale developer enablement, platform engineering, or DevEx programs.

- Scripting and automation skills for mass repository operations at scale.

- Experience defining and tracking engineering productivity metrics.

- A track record of public speaking, community talks, or technical content creation.

Success in the first 12 months

- A standardized, reusable AI configuration pattern adopted across the repository estate, with a clear path to covering 500 repositories.

- Enablement shifted from slow one-to-one mentoring to a scalable program of classes, templates, and self-service assets.

- Measurable, reported productivity impact from AI-enabled teams, trending toward the 40% target.

- A recognized internal community of AI champions inside the delivery teams.

* The final basic wage component can be increased accordingly to individual skills and experience of the selected candidate.

title: AI Security Engineer (m/f/n)
description:
Summary
You will become part of the newly established AI Threat Research and AI Conversation Security team within the Technology Division in Bratislava. As a founding member, you have a unique opportunity to shape the team's direction and methodology from the ground up. The team researches attacks against conversational AI systems — probing and breaking them to understand how adversaries exploit large language models.

Job description

Beyond research, the team designs and implements detection mechanisms and translates these defenses into shipping products across endpoint, cloud, and standalone form factors.

As a Conversational AI Security Engineer, you bridge adversarial research and production engineering — building detection mechanisms to defend conversational AI systems and shipping those defenses as products. Your work spans the full lifecycle, from breaking models to running detection in production.

About the Role

- Research attacks against conversational AI systems — exploring, probing, and breaking them to discover vulnerabilities before adversaries do.
- Design and propose mitigations, protections, and detection strategies based on findings from adversarial research.
- Build a multilayered detection core, combining different approaches to identify malicious prompts and attempts to manipulate AI systems.
- Productize detection capabilities — packaging and deploying them across endpoint, cloud, and standalone environments.
- Collaborate with the broader threat detection department, product teams, and endpoint teams to integrate defenses into shipping security solutions.
- Evaluate and experiment with open-source and proprietary AI tooling to stay current with the rapidly evolving attack surface.
- Shape the team's technical direction and methodology as a founding member, with the opportunity to grow into a Team Lead role over time.

Essential Requirements

- Strong software engineering background — ability to build production systems, not just prototypes.

- Proficiency in Python for building detection and security tooling.

- Understanding of how large language models work and how they can be manipulated or attacked, including prompt injection, jailbreaking, and adversarial inputs.

- Ability to work independently in a newly forming team with minimal defined processes.

Desirable Requirements

- Experience with machine learning and AI, including fine-tuning and deploying language models.

- C++ for performance-critical detection components.

- Background in cybersecurity or threat research.

Technologies

Python, C++, PyTorch, TensorFlow, Hugging Face, scikit-learn, vLLM, Ollama, ONNX, Docker, Kubernetes, AWS, Hadoop, Spark, Kafka, OpenClaw, OpenCode, Git, JIRA, Confluence

Key Responsibilities

Partner Technical Enablement

- Provide technical pre-sales support to strategic channel partners, distributors, MSPs, and resellers.
- Conduct product presentations, demonstrations, workshops, webinars, and technical training sessions.
- Support partners in identifying customer requirements and recommending appropriate ESET solutions.
- Develop and localize technical documentation, deployment guides, best practices, and sales enablement materials.
- Support partner technical certification and competency development initiatives.

Solution Consulting & Sales Support

- Work closely with the Sales team to support customer and partner opportunities throughout the sales cycle.
- Design and present cybersecurity architectures and solution proposals.
- Assist partners and customers with Proof of Concept (PoC) planning, execution, and evaluation.
- Provide technical guidance during customer onboarding, deployment, and migration projects.
- Support upsell and cross-sell opportunities through technical consultations.

HQ Collaboration & Technical Escalation

- Act as a primary technical liaison between Japanese partners/customers and ESET global teams.
- Collaborate closely with Product Management, Customer Care, Security Monitoring, Technical Support, and Product Marketing teams.
- Coordinate technical escalations and facilitate resolution of complex customer issues.

Cloud, MDR & Security Service Adoption

- Assist partners in developing cybersecurity service offerings utilizing ESET technologies.

- Identify opportunities to improve customer retention and increase product adoption.

Industry Engagement

- Represent ESET at partner events, cybersecurity conferences, seminars, and industry activities.
- Deliver technical presentations to customers, partners, and industry audiences.
- Maintain strong awareness of industry trends, competitive solutions, emerging threats, and cybersecurity technologies.

Qualifications

Required

- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Cybersecurity, or related field, or equivalent experience.

- Experience supporting channel partners, distributors, MSPs, or reseller ecosystems.
- Excellent presentation, communication, and technical training skills.
- Strong troubleshooting and problem-solving capabilities.
- Business-level Japanese and professional-level English communication skills (written and verbal).
- Ability to lead technical discussions with both Japanese customers and global stakeholders.

Preferred

- Experience with Endpoint Security, EDR, XDR, MDR, Threat Intelligence, or Managed Security Services.
- Experience working in multinational organizations.
- Experience collaborating with Product Management or technical HQ teams.
- Security-related certifications such as CISSP, Security+, CEH, GIAC, Microsoft Security, or equivalent.
- Knowledge of cloud platforms and SaaS security technologies.
- Experience developing technical enablement programs for channel partners.

Success Profile

The ideal candidate is a technically skilled cybersecurity professional who can effectively communicate complex topics to both business and technical audiences. description:
Summary

Job description

ČO ŤA NA TEJTO POZÍCII ČAKÁ?

Cloud a infraštruktúrna stratégia

- Definovanie a realizácia stratégie pre cloudové a infraštruktúrne platformy.
- Zodpovednosť za technologickú roadmapu v oblastiach AWS, Azure, GCP a hybridnej infraštruktúry.
- Identifikácia príležitostí na automatizáciu, modernizáciu a optimalizáciu služieb.
- Návrh štandardov, procesov a industry best practices pre správu cloudových prostredí.

Architektúra a technické vedenie

- Dohľad nad návrhom, implementáciou a prevádzkou cloudových riešení.
- Konzultácie a podpora technických tímov pri návrhu architektúr a výbere služieb.
- Podpora využívania Infrastructure as Code (Terraform/openTofu), automatizácie a DevOps princípov.
- Zabezpečenie vysokej dostupnosti, disaster recovery a business continuity riešení.

Prevádzka a Service Management

- Zodpovednosť za poskytovanie služieb v súlade s definovanými SLA a KPI.
- Dohľad nad riešením incidentov, problémov a zmien.
- Monitorovanie dostupnosti, výkonu, bezpečnosti a nákladov cloudových služieb.
- Riadenie kapacity, kontinuitných plánov a prevádzkových rizík.

Bezpečnosť a Governance

- Zabezpečenie súladu s internými bezpečnostnými politikami a regulačnými požiadavkami.
- Dohľad nad správou identít, prístupov a bezpečnostných mechanizmov v cloudovom prostredí.
- Podpora zavádzania cloud governance a FinOps princípov.
- Riadenie auditných a compliance aktivít v zverených oblastiach.

Stakeholder & Vendor Management

- Spolupráca s internými zákazníkmi, architektmi, bezpečnostnými tímami a externými dodávateľmi.
- Riadenie vzťahov s technologickými partnermi a poskytovateľmi cloudových služieb.
- Príprava reportov, prezentácií a odporúčaní pre vyšší manažment.

Vedenie tímu

- Riadenie, rozvoj a motivácia tímu cloudových a infraštruktúrnych špecialistov.
- Nastavovanie cieľov, priorít a rozvojových plánov členov tímu.
- Hodnotenie výkonnosti, poskytovanie spätnej väzby a podpora kariérneho rastu zamestnancov.
- Participácia na nábore, onboardingu a rozvoji nových kolegov.
- Plánovanie kapacít a efektívne riadenie pracovného zaťaženia tímu.

ČO OD TEBA OČAKÁVAME?

- Jeden z AWS/Azure na expertnej úrovni. Skúsenosť s Google Cloud Platform alebo inými Cloud Services výhodou.

- Rozumieť konceptom Infrastructure as a code: Terraform/Bicep/openTofu – automatizácia a deployment

- Skúsenosť s Kubernetes(K8s), DevOps principy, Least privilege access, RBAC, IAM konceptmi.

- Znalosť akéhokoľvek programovacieho jazyka je výhodou.

- Znalosť MS SQL a Windows server je výhodou.

title: Country Manager for ESET Nederland
description:
Summary
Lead ESET’s growth, people, and market success in the Netherlands.

At ESET, we protect businesses and individuals around the world with industry-leading cybersecurity solutions. As we continue to strengthen our position in the market, we are looking for an experienced and commercially driven Country Manager to lead our local organization and drive the next phase of growth.

Job description

This is a unique opportunity for a strategic and inspiring leader who combines strong business acumen with a passion for people leadership. As Country Manager, you will be responsible for shaping and executing the local growth strategy, leading Sales and Marketing teams, strengthening key customer and partner relationships, and representing ESET both internally and externally.

While the Country Manager has direct leadership responsibility for Sales and Marketing, the role also plays a key part in shaping the overall direction, culture, and success of ESET Nederland by fostering alignment and collaboration across the local leadership team and wider organization.

You will play a critical role in translating global strategy into local success while ensuring ESET remains a trusted cybersecurity partner across the market.

For the right candidate, this role represents an excellent opportunity to take the next step in their leadership journey and expand their impact beyond commercial leadership into overall market leadership.

What will you be responsible for?

Driving business growth

- Define and execute the local business strategy in line with ESET’s global vision and objectives.

- Deliver sustainable revenue growth across customer segments and sales channels.

- Translate market opportunities into actionable commercial initiatives and measurable business results.

- Own business planning, forecasting, budgeting, and performance management.

- Monitor market trends, competitive developments, and customer needs to identify new growth opportunities.

- Provide market insights and recommendations that help shape business decisions and future strategy.

Leading people and driving impact

- Lead and inspire local Sales and Marketing teams, creating a shared vision and clear direction.

- Empower leaders and teams to take ownership, make decisions, and deliver results.

- Foster collaboration across teams and with international stakeholders to achieve common goals.

- Support the growth and development of leaders and talent across the organization.

- Build an environment where people are encouraged to learn, adapt, and continuously improve.

- Provide coaching, direction, and strategic guidance to your leadership team.

- Actively champion ESET’s People First strategy by fostering a culture of trust, ownership, collaboration, and continuous development, while ensuring the impact on people is considered in business and leadership decisions.

- Work closely with People & Culture and local leaders to strengthen leadership effectiveness, employee engagement, talent development, and organizational health across the country organization.

Building strategic relationships

- Develop and maintain executive-level relationships with key customers, partners, distributors, and stakeholders.

- Act as a trusted advisor and ambassador of the ESET brand in the local market.

- Support strategic negotiations and help secure significant business opportunities.

- Ensure customer and partner feedback is reflected in business decisions and future growth initiatives.

Partnering across ESET

- Collaborate closely with regional and global leadership teams to ensure strategic alignment.

- Bring valuable market insights and recommendations to support product, business, and commercial decisions.

- Represent local market needs and opportunities within the wider ESET organization.

- Contribute to ESET’s long-term strategic direction and business success.

- Work closely with local functional leaders to create alignment across the organization and ensure commercial priorities and broader organizational objectives support the overall success of ESET Nederland.

What are we looking for?

- Proven success in a senior commercial leadership role such as Channel Director, Sales Director, Commercial Director, Business Unit Leader, General Manager, or a similar position.

- Strong track record of delivering business growth and commercial results.

- Experience leading Sales and Marketing organizations in a dynamic and competitive environment.

- Ability to balance strategic thinking with hands-on execution.

- Strong understanding of channel, partner, and customer-led business models.

- Excellent stakeholder management and relationship-building skills.

- Demonstrated ability to lead through influence, collaboration, and strong business judgment.

- Experience working across functions and aligning diverse stakeholders around common business goals.

- Strong financial, forecasting, and business planning capabilities.

- Excellent communication, negotiation, and presentation skills.

- Fluency in English and Dutch.

What will help you succeed

- You are comfortable stepping outside your core area of expertise and learning new aspects of the business.

- You thrive in environments where not everything is fully standardized and are able to navigate ambiguity with confidence.

- You can quickly connect the dots across different business areas and make pragmatic decisions.

- You enjoy building relationships, creating alignment, and bringing people together around common goals.

- You lead with a people-first mindset and understand that sustainable business success is enabled by engaged and empowered teams.

- You are curious, adaptable, and motivated by continuous learning and growth.

Nice to have

- Experience in technology, software, cybersecurity, SaaS, or other fast-evolving industries.

- Experience working in an international or matrix organization.

- Understanding of enterprise, channel, retail, and partner ecosystems.

Why join ESET?

- Lead one of the world's most recognized cybersecurity brands and shape the strategic direction and growth of an important market.

- Take on a role with significant visibility, impact, and autonomy while collaborating with talented international teams and senior leaders across the organization.

- Be part of a company that combines technology excellence, innovation, and a People First culture, where leaders are empowered to make a meaningful difference.

- Accelerate your leadership journey and expand your influence at both local and international levels.

- Enjoy a healthy work-life balance with 30 vacation days and flexible hybrid working arrangements.

- Invest in your continuous growth through a dedicated annual learning and development budget and access to ongoing leadership development opportunities.

- Benefit from a comprehensive wellbeing offering, including a monthly wellness allowance, fitness initiatives, and participation in the company cycle scheme.

- Build your future with a strong pension plan and a competitive total rewards package.

- Receive support for hybrid working through home office and internet allowances.

- Take advantage of commuting support, company-provided technology, and a company lease car as part of the role.

Success in this role means

- Delivering sustainable business growth and achieving commercial objectives.

- Strengthening ESET’s market position and brand presence.

- Building strong and lasting relationships with customers and partners.

- Creating alignment across functions and contributing to the success of the overall country organization.

- Developing engaged teams, effective leaders, and a strong leadership culture.

- Championing ESET’s People First approach while delivering business results.

- Translating strategy into tangible business outcomes and long-term market success.

Náš tím

DWH tím je súčasťou oddelenia Business Intelligence spolu s analytickým a reportingovým tímom. Spoločne zabezpečujeme dátové riešenia pre potreby spoločnosti. Pracujeme v agilných tímoch rozdelených podľa jednotlivých tém. Náplňou DWH tímu je rozvoj a prevádzka dátového skladu.

Čo práca v našom tíme obnáša?

- Návrh, vývoj a manažment databázových riešení na MS SQL platforme

title: Demand Generation Specialist
description:
Summary
Demand Generation Specialist is primarily responsible for planning and executing demand generation initiatives that support customer acquisition, pipeline creation, customer expansion, and sales enablement across B2B, B2C online, and retail channels. As a secondary focus, this role manages social media activities to strengthen engagement and campaign amplification, while supporting PR, external communications, and event execution in alignment with Japan priorities and global marketing plans.

Job description

Key Responsibilities

Primary Responsibility: Demand Generation & Campaign Execution

- Execute marketing campaigns to generate MQLs, SQLs and new business opportunities with existing and prospective customers.
- Run multi-channel programs including digital advertising, social media, email marketing, content syndication and traditional advertising.
- Monitor campaign KPIs, lead generation performance and funnel progress, and identify areas for improvement.
- Ensure campaign and lead information is regularly updated in CRM.

Primary Responsibility: Content & Marketing Communications for Demand Generation

- Develop web content, sales enablement materials, lead magnets, blogs, articles, email copy and campaign assets.
- Localize global assets for the Japanese market and coordinate production with internal creative teams or external agencies.
- Create clear and accurate messaging for both B2B and B2C audiences.
- Apply SEO principles to improve engagement and online visibility.

Secondary Responsibility: Social Media & Digital Communications

- Plan, create, publish and manage content across relevant social media platforms.
- Execute social media activities linked to campaigns, events and awareness programs.
- Monitor comments and simple inquiries, and escalate complex issues to appropriate teams.
- Coordinate written, visual and video content production for social channels.

Supporting Responsibility: PR & External Communications

- Support the preparation and distribution of press releases, articles, interviews and media materials.
- Assist with media communication, press briefings, roundtables and event-related communications.
- Maintain consistency of brand voice and messaging across local and global stakeholders.
- Monitor brand mentions, keywords, hashtags and media coverage where required.

Supporting Responsibility: Events & Webinars

- Execute seminars, webinars, exhibitions, partner events and customer events.
- Manage event invitations, attendee tracking, operations, surveys, lead capture, follow-up and performance measurement.
- Coordinate with Sales, partners, HQ and external vendors to support event objectives.

Reporting & Improvement

- Prepare regular and ad-hoc reports on campaign, PR, social media and event performance.
- Analyze results and turn findings into improvements for future activities.
- Support marketing operations such as budget tracking, PO creation and invoice checks where required.

Requirements

Required

- 3+ years of experience in one or more of the following areas: demand generation, marketing campaign execution, PR, social media, content marketing or event operations.
- Experience in copywriting, content writing, editing and proofreading.
- Experience working with multiple stakeholders including internal teams, agencies, vendors, media or partners.
- Experience managing campaign or event execution, KPI tracking and reporting.
- Excellent written and verbal communication skills in Japanese.
- Business-level English for reading global materials, email communication and basic collaboration with global teams.
- Practical experience with Microsoft Office for document creation, data organization and reporting.

Preferred

- Experience in IT, cybersecurity, SaaS or B2B technology marketing.
- Experience with CRM, marketing automation or analytics tools such as Salesforce, BI tools or digital analytics platforms.
- Hands-on experience with press releases, media relations, press briefings or PR events.
- Experience managing corporate social media accounts, content calendars, social campaigns and engagement analysis.
- Knowledge of SEO, web content optimization, digital advertising and email marketing.
- Experience directing production of videos, articles, blogs, white papers or event reports.

ポジション概要

Demand Generation Specialistは、B2Bチャネル、B2Cオンライン、リテール領域における顧客獲得、パイプライン創出、既存顧客拡大、営業活動支援に向けたデマンドジェネレーション施策の企画・実行を主な責任とするポジションです。副次的な責任として、キャンペーン連動やエンゲージメント向上を目的としたSNS運用を担当します。また、PR・対外コミュニケーションおよびイベント運営は、Japanの戦略優先事項とグローバルマーケティング計画に沿って支援責任として担当します。

主な役割・業務内容

主責任：デマンドジェネレーション・キャンペーン実行

- 既存顧客および新規顧客向けのマーケティング施策を実行し、MQL/SQL創出および新規商談創出を支援する。
- コンテンツシンジケーション、デジタル広告、SNS、メールマーケティング、広告施策など複数チャネルを活用したキャンペーンを推進する。
- キャンペーンごとのKPI、リード獲得状況、ファネル進捗を確認し、改善施策を実行する。
- CRMへの情報更新、リード管理、営業・マーケティング連携に必要な情報整備を行う。

主責任：デマンドジェネレーションに向けたコンテンツ・マーケティング制作

- Webコンテンツ、営業支援資料、リード獲得用コンテンツ、ブログ、記事、メール文面などの企画・制作を行う。
- グローバル提供コンテンツを日本市場向けにローカライズし、必要に応じて外部制作会社や社内クリエイティブチームと連携する。
- B2BおよびB2Cの対象読者に合わせ、わかりやすく正確なメッセージに編集する。
- SEOやオンラインでの可視性を意識し、コンテンツの改善を行う。

副次責任：SNS・デジタルコミュニケーション

- 各種ソーシャルメディアプラットフォームにおける投稿計画、コンテンツ作成、投稿、コミュニティ対応を実行する。
- キャンペーンやイベントと連動したSNS施策を企画・実行し、エンゲージメント向上を図る。
- 投稿結果、コメント、簡易問い合わせ、SNS上の反応を確認し、必要に応じて関係者へエスカレーションする。
- 動画、画像、短文コピーなど、SNS向けコンテンツ制作や外部制作会社との進行管理を行う。

支援責任：PR・対外コミュニケーション

- 社内関係者および外部パートナーと連携し、プレスリリース、記事、インタビュー、メディア向け資料などの作成・配信を支援する。
- メディア対応、記者説明会、ラウンドテーブル、イベント関連コミュニケーションなどの基本的なPR業務を支援する。
- ブランドボイスとメッセージの一貫性を保ちながら、グローバルおよびローカルの関係者と連携する。
- 必要に応じて、ブランド言及、キーワード、ハッシュタグ、掲載状況などのモニタリングを行う。

支援責任：イベント・ウェビナー運営

- セミナー、ウェビナー、展示会、パートナーイベント、顧客向けイベントの準備・運営・フォローアップを担当する。
- イベント案内、参加者管理、当日運営、アンケート、リード獲得、事後フォロー、効果測定まで一連の実務を推進する。
- 営業、パートナー、HQ、外部ベンダーと連携し、イベントの目的達成に向けて必要な調整を行う。

レポーティング・改善

- 定期レポートおよびアドホックレポートを作成し、施策の成果、課題、改善点を整理する。
- マーケティング施策の実行状況、広告・SNS・イベント・PR活動の結果を確認し、次の施策に反映する。
- 予算、発注、請求書確認など、必要なマーケティング運営業務をサポートする。

応募資格

- 英語資料の読解、メール対応、グローバルチームとの基本的な業務コミュニケーションができる英語力

Le développeur logiciel a pour rôle de soutenir le travail des chercheurs sur les menaces d’ESET en concevant et en maintenant des outils internes, de l’automatisation et des pipelines de données qui accélèrent la production de renseignement sur les menaces exploitable.

Description du poste / Job description

Il s’agit d’un rôle de soutien intégré à l’équipe de recherche. Vous n’effectuerez pas vous-même de rétro-ingénierie de logiciels malveillants. Vous supprimerez plutôt les frictions qui ralentissent le travail des chercheurs : unifier des métadonnées dispersées, automatiser le passage de l’analyse aux livrables client, et offrir aux chercheurs une seule interface efficace plutôt que dix.

Rencontrez l’équipe

ESET Research est une équipe de plus de 30 chercheurs qui analyse des opérations complexes de cyberespionnage et de cybercriminalité. Nous travaillons en collaboration avec d’autres équipes internes pour améliorer les produits ESET et créer des détections de logiciels malveillants résilientes.

Notre objectif principal est de comprendre comment les groupes d’attaquants fonctionnent afin de mieux protéger nos clients et de contrer les activités malveillantes. Nous rédigeons également des rapports privés, disponibles aux clients abonnés à notre offre ESET Threat Intelligence.

Nous partageons nos connaissances publiquement sur le blog d’ESET, https://www.welivesecurity.com/research/ et lors de conférences techniques dans le monde entier (Virus Bulletin, Black Hat, RSA, Botconf, etc.).

À propos du rôle

- Concevoir et maintenir des outils internes qui unifient les métadonnées d’échantillons provenant de plusieurs systèmes internes et externes (télémétrie réseau, environnements d’analyse automatisée, collections de logiciels malveillants, plateformes de renseignement sur les menaces (CTI)) afin de rendre les données de renseignement sur les menaces consultables et réutilisables.

- Développer et maintenir des pipelines automatisés qui transfèrent les résultats d’analyse vers les plateformes CTI, par exemple MISP, et génèrent des livrables destinés aux clients, tels que des tableaux d’IOC et des ensembles d’indicateurs.

- Créer des applications Web et des processus destinés aux chercheurs pour la recherche d’échantillons, le triage, le suivi des analyses et l’étiquetage.

- Gérer le carnet de priorités des outils en collaboration avec les chercheurs.

- Collaborer avec les équipes d’ingénierie responsables des systèmes internes, notamment la télémétrie et les environnements d’analyse automatisée.

- Identifier de façon proactive les problèmes de fiabilité, de performance et d’exactitude des services avant qu’ils ne deviennent des incidents, et améliorer les procédures, les tableaux de bord, les alertes et l’automatisation.

Exigences essentielles

- Expérience en Python et JavaScript, avec une expérience démontrée dans la conception, le développement et la maintenance de systèmes Python assortis d’une réelle responsabilité opérationnelle, et non uniquement dans la rédaction de scripts ou l’automatisation.

- Création et maintenance d’API, de bases de données, de files d’attente et d’intégrations de données entre plusieurs systèmes, y compris la conception de schémas et l’optimisation des requêtes.

- Bonne compréhension des processus en renseignement sur les menaces, suffisante pour comprendre le travail des chercheurs dans les systèmes internes, sans devoir être spécialiste en rétro-ingénierie de logiciels malveillants.

- Expérience dans le développement d’applications Web.

- Expérience avec les technologies de conteneurisation, par exemple Docker, CI/CD, Git et l’automatisation des tests.

- Pratiques de développement sécurisé pour des systèmes manipulant des fichiers malveillants et des données sensibles.

- Solides compétences en collaboration et en découverte des besoins, avec la capacité de transformer des irritants en outils livrés et utilisés.

- Une maîtrise professionnelle de l’anglais (niveau B2) est indispensable pour lire les rapports et documents produits par nos équipes internationales, préparer de la documentation en anglais et communiquer avec des collègues de nos autres bureaux ESET

Atouts

- Familiarité avec les processus d’analyse de logiciels malveillants et les métadonnées courantes d’échantillons, notamment les hash, le type de fichier, les packers, les chaînes, les imports, les indicateurs réseau et les comportements observés en environnements d’analyse automatisée, ainsi qu’une expérience avec de tels environnements (CAPE, Cuckoo, Joe Sandbox, Any.Run) ou des équivalents internes comme sources de données.

- Familiarité avec MITRE ATT&CK et la mise en correspondance des comportements de logiciels malveillants avec ces techniques.

- Expérience dans l’utilisation réfléchie d’outils assistés par l’IA, à la fois pour accélérer le développement appuyé par une planification rigoureuse et pour alimenter des fonctionnalités destinées aux chercheurs, comme la génération de rapports ou l’extraction structurée, avec un bon jugement quant à la validation, à la qualité du code et aux limites de sécurité.

- Familiarité avec la création d’outils modernes avec différentes interfaces (CLI, TUI ou WebUI).

- Expérience antérieure dans la livraison d’outils à des équipes de renseignement sur les menaces ou de recherche en sécurité.

- Participation à des CTF.

Composante salariale de base pour le site de Bratislava (brut) : à partir de 2 700 EUR

* La composante salariale de base finale peut être augmentée en fonction des compétences et de l’expérience du candidat sélectionné.
* Prime de performance versée deux fois par an, pouvant atteindre jusqu’à 10 % du salaire de base pour la période d’évaluation (généralement 6 mois).

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

Support ESET Threat Research by building and maintaining internal tools, automation, and data pipelines that accelerate the delivery of actionable threat intelligence.

This is a support role embedded in the research team. You will not reverse malware yourself. You will remove the friction around how researchers work: unifying scattered metadata, automating the path from analysis to customer deliverables, and giving researchers one good interface instead of ten.

Meet the Team

ESET Research is a team of 30+ researchers all over the world who analyze complex cyber-espionage and cybercrime operations. We work in collaboration with other internal teams to improve ESET products and create resilient malware detections.

Our primary goal is to understand how threat groups operate in order to better protect our customers and disrupt malicious activities. We write private reports that are available to ESET Threat Intelligence customers.

We share our knowledge publicly on ESET’s blog, https://www.welivesecurity.com/research/, and at technical conferences all around the world (Virus Bulletin, Black Hat, RSA, Botconf, etc.).

About the Role

- Build and maintain internal tools that unify sample metadata across multiple internal and external systems (network telemetry, sandbox, malware repository, TI platform) and make threat intelligence data searchable and reusable.

- Develop and maintain automated pipelines that move analysis outputs into TI platforms (e.g. MISP) and generate customer-facing deliverables such as IOC tables, indicator packages, and report skeletons.

- Proactively identify reliability, performance, and correctness issues services before they become incidents — improve runbooks, dashboards, alerting, and automation.

Essential Requirements

- Familiarity with threat intelligence workflows — enough to understand what researchers do across internal systems, without needing to be a malware reverser.

- Familiarity with MITRE ATT&CK and mapping malware behavior to techniques.

- Experience using AI-assisted tooling thoughtfully — both to accelerate development backed by sound planning and to power researcher-facing features (report generation, structured extraction), with strong judgment about validation, code quality and security limitations.

- Familiarity with building modern CLI/TUI/WebUI tooling.

Month-end closing

Summary
Hledáme člověka, který bude mít na starosti, aby naše kancelář každý den fungovala tak, jak má.

- Zajištění každodenního chodu kanceláře a dohled nad tím, aby vše fungovalo tak, jak má.
- Zajištění chodu recepce, vyřizování telefonátů a e-mailů, příchozí a odchozí pošty a dalších souvisejících administrativních úkolů.
- Péče o návštěvy – jejich přivítání, uvedení do zasedacích místností, příprava občerstvení a zajištění všeho potřebného pro jejich pohodlí.
- Péče o společné prostory kanceláře a dohled nad jejich čistotou, pořádkem a celkovým vzhledem v průběhu dne.
- Správa parkování pro kolegy.
- Zajištění chodu kuchyněk – doplňování nápojů a dalších zásob, péče o myčky, lednice, kávovary a další vybavení.
- Pravidelné objednávání kancelářských potřeb, potravin, občerstvení a dalších věcí potřebných pro chod kanceláře.
- Péče o zásoby – jejich převzetí, vybalení, doplnění a průběžná kontrola toho, co je potřeba objednat.
- Příprava zasedacích místností pro schůzky, školení, semináře a další interní či externí akce.
- Zajišťování hotelů, jízdenek, letenek, parkování a dalších souvisejících služeb.
- Být kontaktním bodem pro kolegy v otázkách spojených s každodenním fungováním kanceláře.
- Řešení drobných provozních problémů a neočekávaných situací.
- Komunikace s externími dodavateli a poskytovateli služeb.
- Administrativní podpora kanceláře, práce s tabulkami, evidence došlých faktur a vystavování objednávek.
- Zastoupení vedoucí kanceláře v době její nepřítomnosti a převzetí části jejích každodenních povinností.
- V případě potřeby zastupování skladníka – například při kompletaci zásilek, přípravě materiálů na konference nebo obchodní a marketingové akce.
- Pracovní doba je fixní, reflektuje provoz kanceláře a sice pondělí – pátek od 8:30 do 17:00, není možné vykonávat ji z domova. Pracovní smlouva zpočátku na dobu určitou s možností prodloužení na neurčitou.

Koho si představujeme:

- Ukončené středoškolské vzdělání ekonomického směru.
- Běžně pracuješ s MS Office – především s Wordem, Excelem a Outlookem
- - Máš přirozený cit pro pořádek a prostředí kolem sebe. Všímáš si věcí a vidíš, co je potřeba udělat, aniž by Ti to někdo musel říkat.

- Jsi samostatný/á, pečlivý/á a dokážeš si svou práci dobře zorganizovat.
- Umíš si poradit i ve chvíli, kdy se sejde několik úkolů najednou, a dokážeš si určit priority.
- Máš přirozenou potřebu věci dotahovat a hledat řešení.
- Domluvíš se anglicky – nebudeš angličtinu používat každý den, ale občas Tě čeká telefonát, návštěva nebo e-mail v angličtině.
- Nástup možný k 1. 11. 2026

Co ESET nabízí?

- Smysluplnou práci v úspěšné technologické společnosti s více než 100 miliony uživatelů po celém světě.
- Stabilní zaměstnání na plný úvazek a roli, ve které uvidíte výsledky své práce.

- Moderní kanceláře na Praze 7 s ergonomickým vybavením, ovocem, zeleninou, kávou, čajem a nealko nápoji po celý den.
- Skvělý tým lidí, se kterými je radost spolupracovat.

title: Senior AI/Machine Learning Researcher (m/f/n)
description:
Summary
You will become part of the Incident Creator and AI Research team within the Technology Division in Bratislava. The team focuses on detecting malicious activity, combining correlation rules with machine learning models to evaluate potential security incidents from terabytes of behavioral data. Beyond detection, the team builds incident-handling tooling for security operators and develops automation, including potential AI SOC.

Job description

As a Senior Machine AI Researcher, you take part in researching, experimenting, and creating the best models to evaluate potential incidents. Beyond that, you look for applications of AI/ML approaches across the entire incident lifecycle, whether signal filtering, incident summarization, or malicious activity mitigation.

About the Role

- Explore new AI/ML opportunities, leveraging your accumulated expertise to evaluate state-of-the-art research and decide what's worth pursuing in our domain.

- Design and run experiments on terabytes of behavioral data (on-prem and cloud), validating ideas before production on dedicated in-house GPU servers — enough compute to compete with the biggest players in the industry.

- Challenge existing solutions and decisions — driving critical discussion in the team.

- Collaborate with data collection, security operations, and software development — identifying promising opportunities to apply AI/ML where it advances real business goals.

- Mentor other researchers and steer the long-term research direction, supporting technical decisions that push the boundaries of AI/ML in cybersecurity.

Essential Requirements

- Deep understanding of the mathematical and statistical principles behind modern ML/AI methods — ability to critically evaluate and adapt models.

- Experience with modern neural network architectures, especially transformers and their variants.

- Strong drive for continuous learning and staying current with state-of-the-art research.

- Ability to work independently across the full research lifecycle — from literature review to experimentation to production-ready solutions.

Desirable Requirements

- University degree in Machine Learning, Data Science, Mathematics, or a related technical field.

- Basic understanding of computer and network security.

- Experience with cloud platforms — AWS preferred.

Technologies

Python, Scikit-learn, PyTorch, TensorFlow, Polars, Hadoop, Spark, Hive, Impala, Iceberg, LanceDB, (My)SQL, Kafka, MLflow, Kubeflow, Argo, Git, JIRA, Confluence, Docker, Kubernetes, Jenkins, AWS.

title: Vertical Threat Intelligence Analyst (m/f/n)
description:
Summary
This role is dedicated to analyzing cyber threats through the lens of specific industry sectors, delivering context-rich threat intelligence that aligns technical findings with sector technologies, processes, regulations, and business impact.

Job description

The analyst translates complex technical intelligence—including eCrime and APT activity—into actionable security and risk insights, sector-relevant risk narratives, and executive-aligned guidance, empowering customers to make informed decisions for their industry environment. They own the end-to-end creation of industry-focused threat intelligence reports, synthesizing internal telemetry, finished intelligence, and OSINT to provide comprehensive, sector-specific assessments.

Meet the Team

ESET Research is a team of 30+ researchers all over the world who analyze complex cyber-espionage and cybercrime operations. We work in collaboration with other internal teams to improve ESET products and create resilient malware detections.

Our primary goal is to understand how threat groups operate in order to better protect our customers and disrupt malicious activities. We write private reports that are available to ESET Threat Intelligence customers.

We share our knowledge publicly on ESET’s blog, https://www.welivesecurity.com/research/, and at technical conferences all around the world (Virus Bulletin, Black Hat, RSA, Botconf, etc.).

About the Role

Industry-focused threat intelligence

- Identify, track and document APT and eCrime actors that are relevant and active in the given sectors. Analyze cyber threats, attacker behavior, campaigns, and trends as they specifically impact these sectors.

- Assess vulnerabilities, technologies, and architectures commonly used in the sector and their exposure to current threats.

Intelligence collection

- Continuously monitor OSINT sources, including:

- Security research and vulnerability disclosures affecting sector-relevant technology stacks

- Publications from sector organizations, government entities, and regulators

- Broader industry trends, geopolitical factors, and other developments impacting cyber risk

- Collaborate closely with in-house Threat Intelligence teams to understand current technical findings, campaigns, and telemetry-based observations.

- Work with strategic/geopolitical analysts to integrate broader context into sector threat assessments.

Intelligence reporting and analysis

- Produce regular industry-focused intelligence reports combining curated and contextualized OSINT in addition to our proprietary intelligence, derived from ESET telemetry and internal research.

- Move beyond isolated cases by identifying, documenting, and explaining sector-specific trends and patterns.

- Clearly articulate operational and business impact relevant to the industry audience.

Other responsibilities

- Act as a subject-matter expert for internal teams, including sales, customer success, and marketing, providing sector-specific threat context. Serve as a bridge between technical Threat Intelligence analysts and customer-facing or business teams. Support sector-specific positioning of Threat Intelligence offerings.

- Deliver threat intelligence briefings to existing and prospective customers within the assigned sectors.

- Represent the company at industry-focused cybersecurity conferences and events.

Essential Requirements

- Possess a strong background in cybersecurity, threat intelligence, or cybersecurity operations, and demonstrate the ability to analyze cyber threats beyond purely technical indicators.

- Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English.

- Demonstrated ability to produce concise, actionable reports that clearly communicate research findings and recommendations, ensuring relevance and impact for industry stakeholders.

- Experience working cross-functionally with technical and non-technical stakeholders.

- Ability to present complex threat intelligence also to non-technical/executive audiences.

Desirable Requirements

- Prior experience working within a specific industry sector, preferably as threat intelligence analyst, SOC analyst, internal security professional or similar role.

- Understanding of regulatory and compliance environments relevant to critical industries (e.g. NIST, NIS2, ISO 27001).

- Experience presenting at conferences or delivering customer briefings.

title: Zákaznická podpora pro partnery pro ESET
description:
Summary
Hledáme kolegu nebo kolegyni, kteří budou partnerům poskytovat podporu, pomáhat jim orientovat se v našich systémech a budovat tak dlouhodobé vztahy založené na důvěře a spolehlivosti. Naším cílem je, aby se ESET stal pro partnery první volbou a dodavatelem, na kterého se mohou kdykoliv obrátit. Nejde o komunikaci s koncovými zákazníky, ale s obchodníky, nákupčími a IT specialisty, kteří očekávají profesionální přístup, rychlou orientaci v problematice a ochotu hledat řešení.

Job description

Pracovní náplň bude především:

- Telefonická a e-mailová komunikace s našimi obchodními partnery.
- Podpora partnerů při práci s našimi interními systémy a partnerským portálem.
- Zpracovávání administrativních požadavků a práce s interními databázemi.
- Spolupráce s obchodním týmem a dalšími odděleními napříč firmou.
- Péče o pozitivní zkušenost našich partnerů za každé situace.
- Vyhledávání informací a řešení situací tak, aby partner vždy dostal odpověď nebo pomoc, kterou potřebuje.

Jak si představujeme ideálního kolegu nebo kolegyni?

- Máte minimálně 2 roky zkušeností v zákaznickém servisu, ideálně v segmentu B2B.
- Komunikace s lidmi je Vaší přirozenou silnou stránkou.
- Je radost s Vámi být v kontaktu. Dokážete partnerům poradit, vysvětlit i uklidnit složitější situaci tak, aby po hovoru měli pocit, že se obrátili na správného člověka.
- Máte příjemný profesionální projev v českém nebo slovenském jazyce.
- Nebojíte se práce v systémech a rychle se orientujete v nových nástrojích a procesech.
- Jste samostatný/á, pečlivý/á, spolehlivý/á a přirozeně zvídavý/á.
- Umíte si organizovat práci a prioritizovat úkoly.
- Dokážete zachovat klid i v náročnějších situacích.
- Nebojíte se zeptat, když si nejste jistý/á, a zároveň umíte převzít odpovědnost za svěřené úkoly.
- Máte komunikativní znalost angličtiny.
- Můžete nastoupit ihned.

Co ESET nabízí?

- Smysluplnou práci v úspěšné technologické společnosti s více než 100 miliony uživatelů po celém světě.
- Stabilní zaměstnání na plný úvazek a roli, ve které uvidíte výsledky své práce.
- Finanční bonusy vyplácené 2x ročně podle výsledků společnosti a pracovního výkonu.
- Týden dovolené navíc, sick days a širokou nabídku benefitů v rámci kafeterie, včetně příspěvků na Multisport kartu, penzijní připojištění nebo životní pojištění.
- Plně hrazený stravenkový paušál ve výši 170 Kč za každý odpracovaný den.
- Možnost dalšího vzdělávání, profesního rozvoje a vzdělávací kurzy.
- Terapii nebo koučink hrazené firmou a asistenční program pro zaměstnance.
- Finanční podporu při významných životních událostech a věrnostní program s dodatečnými benefity pro dlouhodobé zaměstnance.
- Moderní kanceláře na Praze 7 s ergonomickým vybavením, ovocem, zeleninou, kávou, čajem a nealko nápoji po celý den.
- Skvělý tým lidí, se kterými je radost spolupracovat.

Více informací o tom, jak se u nás pracuje, se dozvíte na Atmoskopu pod profilem ESET software, spol. s r.o.

Pošlete nám svůj životopis a nebo odkaz na LinkedIn profil a pár slov o sobě. Budeme se těšit na setkání.
